method: Read all253 retained useful propositions, all53 complete context profiles and eight exact caption/governor sets against complete base1659–2140 native language, worker, routing, readiness and risk source plus exact authority/trusted-time contexts and all amendment clauses. Verify all988 ordered occurrences, every original full payload and exact insertion-split fragments. Independently retain five pure fail-closed/UNKNOWN-propagation predicates rather than adding broad mechanism governors. Verify original020 and additive withdrawal custody; seven baselineXML proposals are withdrawn without modifying their already-reconciled identities or original caption membership. Source function names are requirements only; no implementation, tests or proof results consulted

decisions.PRESERVED_MODES_AND_LANGUAGE_AUTHORITY: The six execution modes, valid-but-never-satisfying UNAVAILABLE state, ordinary UI/advanced details split, agent test-design/compiler role and application-only language authority are unchanged. D closes actual representability and validation separately; F creates no executor or semantic invention permission.
decisions.PRESERVED_TEST_FIELD_IDENTITY: Exact AGENT/APPLICATION producer assignments and NONE/TEST_IR or closed-loop-test-spec/1 structural format remain. D changes semantic content/registry identities, not these field owners or structural format label. No old operation/parser digest is thereby endorsed.
decisions.EXACT_NATIVE_FIELD_PRIMITIVE_AND_ROUTE_G: Preserve each of eight exact caption texts, original governed occurrence ranges and individual governed ID sets, including dependencies outside this batch. No adjacent standalone duty or amendment clause is absorbed; withdrawing seven duplicate proposals does not remove them from original caption scope.
decisions.PRESERVED_EXPLICIT_DAG: D expressly preserves explicit topological DAG and named-port discipline: unique steps, one registered op, exactly one explicit literal/binding/earlier-output input, no ambient state/hidden stack or accumulator, exact left/right and actual/expected ports, no failed-output consumption or partial results. Concrete operation type/error outcomes are separate changed predicates.
decisions.PRESERVED_PRIMITIVE_AUTHORITY: Existing explicit artifact/byte primitives, one canonical IR language and the demonstrated otherwise-unrepresentable acceptance-case prerequisite for any added primitive remain. D authorizes no extra primitive or alternate language and preserves explicit DAG compilation fidelity.
decisions.PRESERVED_BOUNDED_INPUTS_AND_ADAPTERS: One/multiple artifacts, literal values and explicit application-selected immutable/hash-bound bindings remain eligible without unrestricted project access. Specialized parsers remain adapters; unsupported native formats or JSON Schema do not acquire native authority. C1 intake structural ZIP accounting does not authorize native test-parser support.
decisions.PRESERVED_RESOURCE_BOUNDARY: Exact native resource categories, centralized explicit documented constants and boundary-test duty remain. D preserves runtime limits; C1 pass-wide intake limits are distinct and cannot be replaced by an implementer-selected budget. No boundary/fault result is asserted.
decisions.PRESERVED_RUNTIME_AUTHORITY_AND_ISOLATIO: Single runtime authority, no second registry/interpreter, one bounded worker with only normalized IR/explicit bytes/immutable metadata, no arbitrary network/project access, timeout termination and UI isolation remain. Named source functions are requirements only; no implementation was inspected.
decisions.PRESERVED_RESULT_AND_RECEIPT_SCHEMA: Each exact result/atomic-receipt field-presence and application-owned direct-command/no-human-proposal-review rule remains. These schema/recording obligations do not endorse actual current hashes, normalization, result values or trust in device time. Actual semantic computations are separately governed.
decisions.PRESERVED_EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY: Gate-consumed canonical result ownership remains APPLICATION even in a shared native/external collection. External observations/tool metadata/evidence/files remain submissions until validated. F2 input support cannot supply native execution, stronger attestation or hidden independence.
decisions.PRESERVED_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_BOUNDARIES: Build/worker/protocol identity-field presence and no-release-bearing result with missing required identity remain, as do explicit DAG/no undeclared binding/inferred operand/later-step/dependent-error access rules. Current operation/selector/parser identities and actual result-port semantics are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_ROUTING_AUTHORITY: Exact test/requirement plan identity references, route/class/operator-action enums, derived-only application ownership and sole routing authority remain. Fixed reviewer/human/system/unavailable destinations and missing file-input/output capability blockers do not change with an input-basis minimum.
decisions.PRESERVED_EXECUTION_EVIDENCE_BOUNDARY: Mandatory unavailable external capability blocks; actual human evidence and actual review-context independence remain required at their proper execution/reservation times, not fabricated at definition authoring. General Stage06 routability supplies neither execution nor independent evidence.
decisions.PRESERVED_RISK_AND_ISOLATION: The nine risk classes, target/purpose-bound human authority for non-read-only/non-safe-reversible actions, UNKNOWN blocking and exact action-contract fields remain. Applicable trusted-time authority is preserved. Invalid fixtures use disposable or explicitly authorized bounded state, never implied user/third-party mutation permission.
decisions.CURRENT_NATIVE_LANGUAGE_VALIDATION_AND_N: Actual faithful expressibility, test validation, normalized executable specification/hash and canonical shortcut compilation consume D closed argument/default, numeric, parser, selector, assertion and error semantics. Application language authority remains; affected semantic identities are fresh/stale until explicit compatible migration and reverification.
decisions.CURRENT_IMMUTABLE_EXECUTION_BINDINGS: Actual validated execution bindings consume D exact types/ports and applicable currentB target availability, F1 accepted independently reviewed compatible subject/test/fixture/target/history binding, and F2 actual native custody or externally supported inputs. Bindings stay explicit/immutable and input support never proves execution or changes executor authority.
decisions.CURRENT_NATIVE_OPERATION_OUTPUT_AND_ERRO: Actual registered cardinality/arity/types/output and deterministic error propagation must encode D exactly. Invalid definitions reject, prestart missing material blocks, started invalid/unrepresentable data is UNDETERMINED and runtime/platform/worker failures are EXECUTION_FAILED. Boolean data is not an assertion disposition; no failed/partial dependency is consumed.
decisions.CURRENT_RESTRICTED_SELECTOR_SUPPORT: Actual restricted selector support/admission now consumes exact D grammar, order, type/cardinality, missing-selection and provenance rules. Full third-party JSONPath/XPath remains unclaimed. Seven previously reconciled original XML ambiguity entries are explicitly withdrawn from this batch and are not overwritten.
decisions.CURRENT_NATIVE_SEMANTIC_IDENTITY_BINDING: Actual semantic language/operation/parser/selector/regex identity bindings, normalized DAG hash and selected result-port interpretation must identify D current semantics. Base21.16 mandates new affected identities and stale earlier results until explicit migration/reverification. No existing digest or build is endorsed.
decisions.CURRENT_NATIVE_RUNTIME_FUNCTIONAL_BEHAVI: Source-required supports/capabilities/validate/execute behavior, actual worker result and execution of a validated DAG now use D exact definition/data/output/error semantics within the same runtime/worker authority. A named source function does not establish any existing implementation conformance.
decisions.CURRENT_EXTERNAL_RESULT_VALIDATION: Actual external validation/normalization includes applicable A closed response contract, B current proof references, E test-bound variance meaning and F1/F2 current compatible execution/subject/input basis. Application remains sole canonical result owner; input echoes prove neither success, hidden independence nor stronger attestation.
decisions.CURRENT_DERIVED_EXECUTION_PLAN: Computed plan mode/capability/executor/route/readiness/blocker/artifact/operator/return values consume applicable D native representability, B current accepted target availability, E test/variance, F1 bounded conditional bindings and F2 proper input basis with currentA response requirements. No enum, writer authority or executor is inferred from input-support strength.
decisions.CURRENT_NATIVE_ROUTING_TRIGGER: The actual positive RUN_IN_APP native-support predicate consumes D supported definitions and applicable current bindings/availability; F2 native custody is required only in its enumerated conditional routes and does not presuppose successful execution. The pure missing-byte branch is separately retained because D/F2 expressly preserve that fail-closed outcome.
decisions.CURRENT_EXTERNAL_ROUTE_INPUT_TRIGGER: Actual positive external-route readiness retains substantive/file-transfer capability and verified required inputs under applicable B/F1 current compatible bindings and F2 support. The standalone missing-capability and missing-byte rejection branches are independently retained without an added semantic governor; no route label supplies observations.
decisions.CURRENT_STAGE06_READINESS: Actual proposition, route, input/artifact/evidence and native-operation readiness consumes applicable A/B/D/E/F1/F2 current contracts. B separates initial structural authoring/admission from accepted reviewed availability evaluation. Preserve future timing and capability conjunction; the exact UNKNOWN truth propagation is separately retained.
decisions.CORRECTION_7166: Base2086–2088 is the exact missing-required-bytes→BLOCKED branch for APPLICATION_DETERMINISTIC. D2086 repeats prestart missing-material BLOCKED and F2 2547 expressly blocks absent/mismatched native inputs without requiring prior execution success. Those clauses preserve this fail-closed branch; the actual positive native support and current binding computations are separately changed. No added semantic governor is needed for this exact branch.
decisions.CORRECTION_7167: Base2096–2098 is the exact missing-substantive-capability→BLOCKED branch for EXTERNAL_AGENT_TOOL, alongside unchanged file-input/output blockers. F1 preserves capability controls and F2 2551 does not waive stronger requirements or grant a capability/executor. The branch remains unchanged; actual capability/compatible-binding determination is separately reviewed.
decisions.CORRECTION_7170: Base2096–2098 requires BLOCKED when an external route lacks required bytes. F2 2549 does not convert downloads/claims/echoes into possession or execution, and missing/mismatched exact input support cannot succeed. The missing-byte fail-closed branch is unchanged; current input identities and positive readiness are separately governed.

A/B/D/E/F1/F2 changes some facts evaluated by current readiness but introduces no new truth table or UNKNOWN coercion. Preserve this exact generic propagation predicate rather than adding all current mechanism governors through shared context.
